name: Imaginary Friend
original_name: イマジナリーフレンド
source:
"Artificial spirit"-.

It's an artificially created imaginary friend.
They seem to supplement their "ability that the summoner lacks" and lead their lives to success.

The main character, Naruse Mukai, is a second-year high school student who is not good at studying. Naruse had a big head on the mid-term exam starting the next day.

"I wonder if anyone can do tomorrow's test instead of me ..."

At that time, Naruse happens to know "How to summon an artificial spirit". Naruse casts a spell with the intention of taking a break, even though he makes a fool of himself.

He never knew at this time that this casual behavior would make a big difference in Naruse's life ...

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/26460]Freem![/url]]
translation:
“人造精神”-。

这是一个人工创造的想象中的朋友。
他们似乎补充了自己“召唤师所缺乏的能力”，并带领自己的人生走向成功。

主角向井成濑是一名学习成绩不佳的高中二年级生。成濑对第二天开始的期中考试感到很头疼。

“不知道有没有人可以代替我来参加明天的考试……”

那时，成濑恰好知道“人工精灵的召唤方法”。成濑为了休息一下而施展了咒语，尽管他自己却出丑了。

此时的他根本不知道，这个不经意的举动，竟然会给成濑的人生带来如此大的改变……
